curriculumAlignmentSummary: Unit 1 covers machine-level data representation, number systems and conversions, binary arithmetic, overflow and underflow, complements, signed/unsigned numbers, floating-point representation, coding schemes (ASCII/Unicode), operating systems and their tasks, process management, file systems, and computer software types, hosting, and programming tools. These concepts map closely to FBISE questions involving number systems, operating system functions, process management, software hosting, and programming environments.
